This initial content is the DIGEST-PLANE field set, EXTENDED by the ADR-037 §4.2 assistant-leg edit (2026-10-14, one edit per the protocol review's assumption 3): the assistant context-block section, the plane enum, the assistant.turn.* event names (plane_own), the advisory_gap values rate_limited/request_oversized (14 values, §4.3), and the assistant context vocabularies (family_state, family_off_reason, family_engage_label, governor_verdict, governor_gap, family_probe_verdict, hosting_listener_state, engine_backend, capacity_class, os_platform, picker_fit). contract.one_gate: Every field leaving the process for the advisory endpoint passes this value-typed allowlist (the content gate), then the shipped modelswarm-telemetry Redactor as a secondary scrub net. A field failing the allowlist is dropped and counted, never sent.

value_types.integer: 64-bit signed integer, JSON number without fraction
value_types.enum: string VALUE-matched against a frozen vocabulary named in this artifact
value_types.peer_ref_16hex: exactly 16 lowercase hex chars: the first 16 hex of SHA-256 over the full base58btc PeerId string (ADR-033 RC-1; the raw base58 PeerId is never emitted)
value_types.profile_ref_16hex: exactly 16 lowercase hex chars: the 16 hex following the msp1: prefix of a ModelProfileId

contract.zero_surviving_fields: a request with zero surviving fields is not sent (gap empty_after_redaction)
contract.choke_point: exactly one function constructs the request body; before CALL the final serialized body is re-parsed, every value must re-match this allowlist, and the bytes must pass scrub_content unchanged — any failure is gap empty_after_redaction and nothing is sent (ADR-033 RC-3)

plane_enum.note: which plane a plane-own telemetry row belongs to (ADR-037 §4.2): advisory.* rows are the digest plane, assistant.* rows are the assistant plane. Both are excluded from digest aggregation (RC-4).

assistant_context_block.note: ADR-037 §3.5: the assistant-plane typed context block. Every field is value-typed against THIS section; a name not listed here never enters an assistant request, and adding a field is an ADR-037 amendment. There is deliberately NO free-text field type: the user's assistant-channel text is the one disclosed exception and rides the request's turn/history members, never the context block. Chat transcripts, serving frames, and ADR-036 carrier payloads have no field type here and no parse path into the builder (the W3 data wall).

value_types.integer: 64-bit signed integer, JSON number without fraction
value_types.enum: string VALUE-matched against the frozen vocabulary named after the colon in the field's type
value_types.display_name_string: bounded string: max 128 chars, no control chars — the signed catalog/candidate display-name class (ADR-033 RC-11 owner-controlled strings)
value_types.gpu_name_string: bounded string: max 128 chars, no control chars — drawn from the engine's device-listing text
value_types.vocab_count_map: object whose keys VALUE-match the frozen vocabulary named after the colon, values integers
value_types.picker_row: object with exactly the picker_row_fields keys, each value-typed per its declared type

reduction_rules.note: composite "X->Y" becomes deadline_ms_requested/deadline_ms_clamped (and the max_tokens pair) as integers; the composite string itself never enters the digest
typed accumulators emit integers (rounded ms); the honest sentinels none/unmeasured/unknown map to null on every timing field
stringified JSON blob; decompose into typed fields via amendment if ever needed
opaque requester-generated string (peer-chosen bytes); correlation rides the peer reference plus integer round
local disclosure strings; no per-field vocabulary is authorized at this leg

aggregation_event_allowlist.note: the enumerated event-type set whose typed accumulators may feed a digest; EXCLUDES every row whose name starts with advisory. (the plane's own telemetry never feeds the next cycle) — ADR-033 §3.2/RC-4

emit_site_events.note: EXHAUSTIVE event-name vocabulary over the node/desktop production telemetry emit sites (R-1: the guards completeness tie diffs the source emit-site vocabulary against this section AND the tests/fixtures/advisory-egress/ manifest - a source event name without a row here, or a row here without a source emit site, is a red build).
